inputs.text: Cuba’s communist rulers have denied ordinary families the security of owning property and rebuilding their lives. Any transition must put that right back where it belongs: with Cuban families, who should be able to own and pass on what they build. But replacing state control with a fire sale to foreign investors or wealthy outsiders would be no real freedom. Order, family ownership and national sovereignty must come first; Cuba’s future belongs to its people.

output.main_topic: Restoring property ownership rights to Cuban families while protecting national sovereignty
